notice.title: Before you start
notice.l1: Each day you file a short report: a few yes/no answers, ratings, a note, and a photo if something is wrong.
notice.l2: Reports are stored by the production office and copied to the tour's Google Drive. No ID documents, bank details or health data are ever asked for.
notice.l3: Sharing your location with a report is optional. Declining it, or switching it off later, changes nothing about your standing.
notice.l4: A day off still needs a report: answer “No” to “Did you work today?” and you are done in two taps.
notice.l5: Questions, or a mistake in your details? Contact: {{contact}}.
